patches.name: Grants - Keyword + Format Direct
patches.description: Template for direct file downloads. Customize the domain for real grant portals.
patches.notes: Replace example.gov with a real site. Good base for many agency open data downloads.

patches.name: Data.gov Catalog (real CKAN)
patches.description: Real US federal open data catalog at catalog.data.gov. Uses q= for keyword and res_format for file type. Excellent for discovering federal grant, contract, and program data.
patches.notes: This is a REAL target. Results pages usually contain resource download buttons. Use 'Use link extraction' for best results. Add date filters via the date pickers.

patches.name: City of Chicago Open Data (real Socrata)
patches.description: Real Chicago open data portal. Great for business licenses, permits, contracts, payments, etc. Many datasets export directly as CSV.
patches.notes: REAL portal: https://data.cityofchicago.org/ . Search the catalog, then use link extraction or target specific known dataset IDs for direct /api/views/XXXX/rows.csv exports.

patches.name: NYC Open Data (real)
patches.description: New York City open data portal (Socrata). Huge collection of city operational data.
patches.notes: Real target. Use for NYC-specific intelligence. Link extraction works well on result pages.

patches.name: Public Tabular CSV (real public data demo)
patches.description: Uses a real publicly hosted CSV for end-to-end testing.
patches.notes: This one is fully live and will actually download + ingest real rows.

patches.name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities (demo pattern)
patches.description: Federal contract search pattern. Good for opportunity monitoring with date filters.
patches.notes: Uses realistic SAM.gov search API shape. Results are often JSON; the extraction path can help surface downloadable attachments.

patches.name: Generic Search Results Page
patches.description: Flexible search page builder for any portal with keyword search in the URL.
patches.notes: Good starting template. Switch to fetch_page_then_extract_links and set link_exts for many real sites.

patches.name: Custom / Ad-hoc URL Template (real examples included)
patches.description: Highest flexibility. The GUI lets you override the template live. Pre-filled examples include real public patterns.
patches.notes: Start with the real data.gov example above, or paste any portal search URL containing {term} and {fmt}. Supports {start_date} too when you set dates.
